the effect of internationalization on firm performance is moderated by diversification.
the internationalization‐firm performance relationship is U‐shaped, but this relationship is moderated by the level of diversification of the firm.

the relationship between international diversification, domestic diversification, and firm performance.
the internationalization of Chinese manufacturing firms.
the internationalization and diversification of firms in an emerging market.
